identity.note: SCCW's own backstage database (lot 0159) carries a Salaok card, whose Other Federations field names BOTH of this record's own wings in one line — "Global Wrestling, Freedom, WCWF" — and which carries this record's own entrance music verbatim ("'Walk' by Pantera") and the same invented "The Harvester of —" moniker this record's aka carries (The Harvester of Minds on the card, The Harvester of Fear here, and the GW tenure's own role line calls him the Harvester of Fear outright). Its billed weight (286) agrees with neither of the two figures the GW announcer gave on one night (156 and 256), which this record already records as a contradiction; recorded, #entity-vs-tenure. Its Other Fed Awards field ("You name it I've done it") asserts nothing and nothing is taken from it.

The counterpart of the assertion on johnathon-davis-gw. The wing holds these two as two men, and its own documents put both on screen together: "Salaok and Jonathon Davis stand in front of the other six figures" in the WrestleCade III footage of 2 May 2003, and, on 31 March 2003, "There in the front row stands The Harvester of Minds, Johnathon Davis" watching this record take a chair to the head. The federation's own database card for this record names the relation - "His older brother, Johnathon, also known as The Scarecrow" - which is the aka johnathon-davis-gw already carries. SOURCES DISAGREE ON THE HARVESTER TITLES and both readings stand (#sources-disagree): this wing's own ring announcer bills this record "the Co-Owner of GW and the Harvester of Fear...Salaok!" and "he is the Harvester of Fear and one-half owner of Global Wrestling, SALAOK!", Silent Wind answers him "But times change Harvester of Fear", and the induction footage has Jonathon, not this record, say "I am The Harvester of Minds."; that card's own nicknames field and prose, and the SCCW card named in the first assertion on this row, put Minds on this record and Fear on the brother. The aka and role line here follow the wing's own served pages and are not changed.
PTC tournaments' own entrant card (GTT4, accession 0159, bio 15273) is this record: the same entrant across PTC's own tournament series (bios 14551,15494), merged there on the tournament's own tags.

Global Wrestling's biography card (accession 0159), bio 4344, is this record: This card's own Other Feds is that same line — 'WCWF, UWF, Freedom' — its entrance is "'Walk' by Pantera" verbatim on both sides, and its Nicknames field is 'The Harvester of Minds' against the held row's aka 'The Harvester of Fear' and its gw role line 'co-owner and Vice President of GW, and the Harvester of Fear'. This card's Fed Titles claim six World reigns. the held `gw` wing IS this federation (DATA-FACTS G2, primary-source: Dallas to the building, four of four show names, four of four titles, the owner and the president, and eight of the ten names on the fed's own February 2006 top ten).
